title: fix(runtime): the comment and webhook redelivery doors' 501 follows the request's language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPE7uyDAJyqjwwMzomWv5ff)_

Fixes #37610

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none (no page under `skills/**` names these doors' `501` sentences)

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：内核缺少评论服务或 webhook 服务时，评论接口和 webhook 重新投递接口返回的 501 提示，现在会按请求的语言（中文、日文、西班牙文）显示，和同一内核上的打印、个人视图、附件接口一致。英文请求看到的英文和以前一字不差。另外，附件接口那句英文原来写成 "doors is not available"，现在改成语法正确的 "are"。
- 为什么做：#37594 的审核发现这两扇门还只说英文，附件那句英文语法也不对。
- 出错会怎样：只影响服务没装好时的 501 提示文字，状态码和错误码都不变。英文只有附件那一句变了（is 改 are），西班牙文附件那句改成复数。
- 要你做什么：无。`packages/spec` 的消息目录有改动，席位会安排契约审核。

## What changes

- **Catalog** (`packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`, `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES`), each in `en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES`:
  - `comment_doors_service_unregistered`, `comment_doors_member_missing`, `webhook_redeliver_service_unregistered`, `webhook_redeliver_member_missing`. The English is the sentence each door answered before, byte for byte; slot, member and package names are written in, untranslated.
  - `own_door_service_unregistered_plural`, `own_door_member_missing_plural`: the bridge's two sentences with a plural verb (`are` / `no están disponibles`; `zh-CN` and `ja-JP` read as the singular pair).
  - `es-ES` `own_door_attachment_mutate` becomes plural ("los puntos de acceso para eliminar y renombrar adjuntos"), to agree with the plural pair.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/comments.ts`, `webhooks.ts`**: the two `501`s each answer `operationUserMessage(key, { locale })`, the locale read by the bridge's own reader, now exported (`requestLocaleOf`, `own-door-bridge.ts`). Code, status and the absence of `userMessage` are unchanged.
- **`own-door-bridge.ts`**: `OwnDoorBridge.nounKey` is required (the type is internal: `packages/runtime/src/index.ts` exports none of it); the English-only arm is gone. A new optional `nounPlural: true` makes the bridge read the `_plural` pair. `attachments.ts` sets it, so the English reads "The attachment removal and rename doors are not available: …".
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/runtime` patch, with a paragraph saying the English moved for the attachment doors.

Small calls made here (no card):
- The card's third item suggested changing the attachment noun; the noun is already plural ("the … doors"), and the verb sits in the shared sentence, so the fix is a plural pair of sentences chosen by a bridge flag rather than a noun change. The English noun and its catalog value stay as they were.
- The comment and webhook doors are not own-door bridges (each has its own sentence), so they get whole sentences in the catalog rather than the bridge's `{{door}}` template.
- The old "a bridge with no noun key stays English" control test is removed with the arm it pinned.

## Why

Review of PR #37594 (record 7196010986, adopted at ACCEPT 7196077328) found the comment and webhook redelivery doors still answering English only, the optional `nounKey` that would let a fourth bridge ship English-only, and the attachment sentence's verb agreement.

## Verification

Head `e2708e28c`, under `os-verify-lock`:
- `packages/runtime`: `own-door-bridge.test.ts`, `comments.test.ts`, `webhooks-redeliver.test.ts`: 3 files, 79 tests passed. New describes pin both `501`s of the comment doors (on every door) and of the redelivery door in en (and with no header), zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES, with no `userMessage`; the attachment pins now read "are" and the plural `es-ES` sentence.
- `tsc --noEmit -p packages/runtime`: exit 0.
- `packages/spec` `src/system/operation-message.test.ts`: 60/60.
- `eslint` on the 8 touched source and test files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: clean.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed (none depend on this catalog).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
